findings.body: The `shorten` function has a branch for when the truncated head contains no space (the `None` arm), and `first_sentence` has a branch for when no `. ` is found. Neither is exercised by the tests: the provided tests cover only the `Some` cases and the short-input path. If these fallback branches were refactored incorrectly, no test would catch it. Add tests with a long string containing no spaces within the limit, and a string without `. `.
findings.title: Add tests for the no-separator branches in summarise

findings.body: This assignment is never used; the variable is not referenced later in the script. The comment claims it keeps `runpy` imported, but `runpy` is already imported at the top of the file and is not otherwise used. Remove the assignment and the import if it is not needed.
findings.existing_code: globals_dict = runpy.run_path.__globals__  # noqa: F841 - keep runpy imported
findings.title: Remove unused globals_dict assignment and misleading comment

value.summary: The change introduces a summarise module with sensible in-crate tests and an opt-in kernel-bypass entrypoint for local MongoDB development. The core logic is correct, but two fallback branches lack test coverage and the shim contains a dead assignment; fixing those would make it ready.
